structure: Part 3 read, at commit 04a073b (checkout HEAD), in full: app/views/design-release-2.1/consignment-details.html (223 lines) and app/views/design-release-2.1/additional-animal-details.html (97 lines); app/routes.js lines 824-1010 (getPackagingFields, isGerminalProductCommodity, getSelectedCommodityRows, buildSpeciesConsignmentEntry, getConsignmentCommodityGroups), 1038-1219 (parse/validate number of animals, packages, net weight, storage temperature; buildRadioItems), 1372-1494 (getUnweanedOptions, getAdditionalAnimalDetailsConfig, requiresAdditionalAnimalDetailsPage, showsGerminalTemperatureQuestion, hasConsignmentDetails, hasAdditionalAnimalDetailsComplete, no-op redirect guards), 1604-1615 (getPostConsignmentDetailsPath, getAdditionalAnimalDetailsBackLink), 10676-10726 (renderConsignmentDetailsPage, renderAdditionalAnimalDetailsPage) and 11309-11522 (GET/POST /consignment-details and /additional-animal-details). To resolve values those lines use, it also read app/data/commodities.js and app/data/commodities-germinal-products.js (packaging fields, unweaned options, germinal flag), app/data/certification-purposes.js (the 16 certification purpose options), routes.js line 60 (germinalTemperatureOptions), getJourneySteps and getNextJourneyPath/getJourneySaveRedirect/getSectionContinueRedirect (1495-1602), hasAnimalIdentifiersRequired (1796), hasGerminalProductsOnly (4448) and the shared partial partials/design-release-2.1/journey-form-actions.html; those are claimed only as far as these two pages use them. Pages covered: /design-release-2.1/consignment-details (page title and heading 'Commodity details', caption 'Description of the goods': selected-commodities summary table with Remove buttons and 'Add another commodity' link, then one section per commodity group and one sub-section per species, with Number of animals plus an optional packages field for live animals, or Total gross weight (kg) and Number of packages for germinal products, and a Temperature radio question with Ambient/Chilled/Frozen when every selected species is a germinal product) and /design-release-2.1/additional-animal-details (heading 'Additional details', caption 'Commodity details': 'What are the animals certified for?' unless the consignment is germinal products only, and 'Does the consignment contain any unweaned animals?' when a selected commodity carries unweaned options and not all are 01061900). Validation, error messages, persistence, journey ordering, back links and the soft-save buttons are claimed for each.
